decisions.reason: The one-page target remains unchanged, and the conditional relocation of the two photos is already owned by the separate photo-placement Requirement.
Relocating two specified photos does not change the current document-wide layout or graphic-treatment rules and should not be duplicated under this broad Requirement.
The source changes where two photos may be placed, not which narrative sections or subsections must be included.
The photo-relocation instruction does not alter any typeface, font-size, or bold-formatting rule.
The source does not change the background treatment of the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
A conditional relocation of proposal-specific photos does not change the deferred reusable-template requirement.
The placement of two photos does not change the Agua Arc identity, logo, or color-source requirements.
The candidate already requires full Canva editability; the photo-relocation decision does not change source delivery, ownership, access, or reuse rights.
Moving photos to another section if necessary does not reorder, add, or remove the fixed RFQ sections.
The source contains no change to hyperlink coverage or functionality.
The source concerns the separate one-page proposal letter and conditional photo placement, not the overall RFQ page-limit target or document-wide spacing strategy.
Relocating two photos does not change the required proposal tables, budget sheet, or table replacements.
